# Always Online

Always Online is integrated with the Internet Archive so that visitors can access a portion of your website even when your origin server is unreachable and a Cloudflare-cached version is unavailable.

> Links below point directly to Markdown versions of each page. Any page can also be retrieved as Markdown by sending an `Accept: text/markdown` header to the page's URL without the `index.md` suffix (for example, `curl -H "Accept: text/markdown" https://developers.cloudflare.com/cache/how-to/always-online/`).
>
> For other Cloudflare products, see the [Cloudflare documentation directory](https://developers.cloudflare.com/llms.txt).

## Always Online documentation pages

- [Always Online](https://developers.cloudflare.com/cache/how-to/always-online/index.md): Serve cached pages when your origin server is unavailable.
